---
title: "Titanic - Static"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv")
```

# Overview

## {.sidebar}

Passenger survival on the Titanic.

## Column

### Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Passengers"
list(icon = "people", color = "primary", value = nrow(df))
```

### Row {height=75%}

```{r}
#| title: Survival by class
ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = Pclass, fill = Survived)) + geom_bar(position = "fill"))
```

```{r}
#| title: Survival by sex
ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = Sex, fill = Survived)) + geom_bar(position = "fill"))
```

# Distributions

## Column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Age
ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, color = Survived)) + geom_density())
```

```{r}
#| title: Fare
ggplotly(ggplot(df, aes(x = Fare, color = Survived)) + geom_density())
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Passengers
datatable(df)
```
